description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures for Redboot FIS format, specifically for the ath79 target in OpenWrt. It includes functions to check image format and to perform system upgrade actions based on the image contents.

methods.name: platform_check_image_redboot_fis
methods.description: Checks whether the provided image has the correct magic word indicating it is in Redboot FIS format.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_redboot_fis
methods.description: Performs the actual upgrade process, extracting kernel and root filesystem from the image and flashing them to the device.
